upcoming.message: From 4 December 2026, solar modules pay an additional Section 232 duty of 15% for goods of the EU, Japan, Korea, Switzerland, Liechtenstein and Taiwan (the amount that brings the normal MFN duty, 0% here, plus Section 232 to 15%: Proclamation 11052, clause 5(b)). That 15% covers the MFN duty and Section 232 only; it is not the total duty. The forced-labor Section 301 tariff is a separate duty and is charged on top of it where the line is not exempt: solar goods are not on that tariff's Section 232 exemption list (HTSUS ch. 99 U.S. note 52(f)). A minimum import price of $0.38 per watt starts the same day. Goods entered before that date are not affected.
